## Your build

- **Title (2–6 words):**
- **Author handle (e.g. X / GitHub):**
- **Author URL:**
- **kernelCAD version used:**

## The prompt

> Paste the exact agent prompt you used to build this. Keep it honest — what you typed, no post-edits.

## The video

Upload a short MP4 (5–30 seconds) showing the build forming and rotating. Promo-grade — no dev tools visible, no voiceover needed. Drag-and-drop into this issue or link to a hosted file.

## Source code

Link to a public `.kcad.ts` file (gist, your own repo, this repo, etc.).

## Tags

3–5 short tags (e.g. `assembly, mates, mechanism`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Video is mine or I have permission to share it
- [ ] Prompt is the actual prompt I used (no embellishment)
- [ ] Source code is publicly viewable
- [ ] I'm OK with the gallery framing "Built with kernelCAD" + author credit
